blocks.html: The data to create, update, or remove variants' prices.

types.name: variantPrices
types.description: The variants to create or update prices for.

children.name: variant_id
children.description: The ID of the variant to create or update prices for.

children.name: product_id
children.description: The ID of the product the variant belongs to.

children.name: prices
children.description: The prices to create or update for the variant.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the money amount.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of this money amount. It's normalized to lowercase when stored. For example, `EUR` is stored as `eur`.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount of this money amount.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity required to be purchased for this money amount to be applied.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity required to be purchased for this money amount to be applied.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules to add to the price. The object's keys are the attribute, and values are the value of that rule associated with this price.

types.name: previousVariantIds
types.description: The IDs of the variants to remove all their prices.
